author: Zintenka
body:
Item Attributes: I found out that ppl made MCEdit filters for these. Currently experimenting. 

Create Geared Mobs then turning them into spawners: Oooohhhh yeah~ I'm gonna use this as a way for ppl to get OP armor. Since maps tend to have OP armor in the middle and ppl find it unfair that someone else took it (If ur that immature). You will have to fight an OP mob for the armor, the armor will have slowness! This is also pertaining to Item attributes.

So far the mob spawner part is working. Attributes still in development.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Item attributes is basically the properties of an item, a mob, or potion. 

For instance, a diamond sword has +7 attack damage. 

Or a Zombie has a follow range of 40 blocks.

Or you have +250 Max Health. 

Attributes are already in game. 

several months earlier, when I made Coup De'tat they said that spawn eggs are allowed. And since a spawner is a block and all blocks are allowed I dont see why not *Wink*

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
IT WORKS!

Item pictures will be posted very soon! Hehehe... Ehahaahhahaahahahahaha! 

For now, here is a sneak peak, it is a wither skelly wearing diamond armor in my custom texture pack.


His attributes are as follows:

The flower has +8 attack damage

The boots have -60% speed (Very slow)

He has +500 knockback resistance (No matter how much you hit him he will be coming for you!) 

He has +20 max health! (An extra row of hearts!)

This will be in implemented in a new map of mine that will be coming soon!

Oh, and its a 100% chance that he drops all his items!
